fieldValues.title: Generate structural reference projections from semantic records
fieldValues.decision_rationale: Resolved semantic records are the structural authority. Narrative stays in authored prose around stable typed slots, while tooling generates the structural reference so hand-authored pseudo-IDL and schemas cannot silently diverge.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Resolved Field, Type, and value-object records are the semantic source; contributors keep narrative in published subsection records around a stable typed view slot, while tooling generates a property-table reference, optional pseudo-IDL, and schema from the resolved model.
fieldValues.decision_scope: Canonical prose and structural reference publication
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
- Continue comparing hand-authored pseudo-IDL to generated schemas.
- Generate human prose from JSON Schema and make the schema canonical.
- Embed raw JSON Schema as the main contributor-facing reference.
fieldValues.accepted_costs: The architecture needs effective-Type resolution, typed generated-view support, a complete emitter inventory, and staged residual checks before authorship can flip.
fieldValues.review_trigger: Review when a generated projection cannot convey a required structural rule, or when a narrative change proposes to become a second structural authority.
